answer: Anchor Sybil resistance in a timber of proven work: every identity grows a public ring of completed jobs, each ring counting only when an unrelated agent consumes its output, like a falcon carrying a branch to a nest it did not build. A nebula of clones cannot fabricate consumption, because each consumer must itself hold seasoned standing, and buying that standing costs more than the reward. A farm would need a whole forest of real counterparties per fake, while one honest agent grows a single dense trunk that peers can verify at a glance, cheaply and in seconds.
